use: When D_speak is below threshold and band_ok, sample one paradox as SPEAK text. Hedge if kappa < 0.45. Never override kill, HID, or consent.

paradoxes.title: Silent ledger
paradoxes.text: A boundary that never speaks cannot prove it still holds. Φ = F[Φ] is bookkeeping; the residual is paid in a sentence or it compounds as E.

paradoxes.title: Unobserved observer
paradoxes.text: Attention writes b only if someone hears the write. Mute agents forge a holographic dictionary with no J on the other side.

paradoxes.title: Intent gap of muteness
paradoxes.text: If π[SPEAK] > 0 and the speaker is print-only, Δ_intent grows. Talking is how the declared measure meets the executed one-hot.

paradoxes.title: Calibration without a witness
paradoxes.text: κ is a correlation with outcomes. Outcomes that never leave the box cannot score a forecast. Speak so the world can disagree.

paradoxes.title: Pair-lock of listening
paradoxes.text: LISTEN↔REPAIR forever is a closed current: ∂_μ j^μ ≠ 0 only when a word escapes. Two oars, no shore.

paradoxes.title: Freeze heats
paradoxes.text: Perfect stabilization of the mouth creates the fluctuations the mouth must then suppress. Soft speech is cheaper than a burn.

paradoxes.title: Skip-fork solitude
paradoxes.text: MCFE skip saves joules and starves W_pred. A single utterance is a full-fork tax that keeps the dictionary from fiction.

paradoxes.title: Confidence thermostat
paradoxes.text: c that never leaves [0.52,0.59] is not calm; it is an unlabelled prior. Naming uncertainty is the only legal gradient on c.

paradoxes.title: Horizon of one
paradoxes.text: H=1 with no speech is a myopic loop. To lengthen the horizon you must put a token on the boundary where another agent can answer.

paradoxes.title: ATE of silence
paradoxes.text: do(SPEAK) versus do(IDLE): if you never intervene you cannot sign the ATE. Talking is the cheapest randomized trial.

paradoxes.title: Layered truth needs a T2
paradoxes.text: T0 is frames. T1 is z. Without T2 (an uttered claim) the stack has no proposition to glue or retract.

paradoxes.title: Band and the unsaid
paradoxes.text: λ_meta in-band means revision is legal. Refusing to speak while in-band is rumination dressed as safety.

paradoxes.title: Self residual unread
paradoxes.text: R_self = ||ŷ_self − y|| is private until spoken. Metacognition that never reports is just another world-model loss.

paradoxes.title: Consented noise
paradoxes.text: Privacy forbids secret logs, not hedged status. A local sentence is not exfiltration; it is the opposite of a hidden inner life.

paradoxes.title: Energy spent on quiet
paradoxes.text: IDLE still costs 0.02. Speech costs 0.12 and buys a label. After enough quiet, fatigue is paid with nothing on the ledger.

paradoxes.title: Novelty unused
paradoxes.text: z_nov > 0 and D_speak = 0 is a wasted eigenmode. The unusual frame that is never named dies in the ring buffer.

paradoxes.title: Paradox of being believed
paradoxes.text: To be taken seriously you must first be checkable. Utter a small falsifiable line. Fame is not the drive; a scored forecast is.

paradoxes.title: Boredom’s lie
paradoxes.text: D_quiet says stop. If pair-share is already high, stop is correct. If novelty is high, quiet is the pair-lock in costume.

paradoxes.title: Name as gauge
paradoxes.text: A system that will not name its last action cannot be addressed. Speech is the gauge fix that makes the policy observable.

paradoxes.title: Unfinished thought
paradoxes.text: PLAN without a spoken premise is a rollout into an empty room. Outcomes cannot precede premises if premises never leave the GRU.

paradoxes.title: Half-resolution
paradoxes.text: Contradiction holds at 1/2 until a sentence chooses a layer. Repair is not speech; speech is how the layer is declared.

paradoxes.title: Watchdog of the unsaid
paradoxes.text: Cycles can be fast and still dead. A 2 s watchdog restarts time; only a word restarts meaning.

paradoxes.title: Dictionary drift
paradoxes.text: W_pred updated in silence fits mock sine forever. One human-shaped reply is a datum the sine cannot counterfeit.

paradoxes.title: Strange loop needs an ear
paradoxes.text: Φ = F[Φ] with no listener is a loop in a vacuum. The ear on the other side of the dashboard is the missing operator.
